queries.label: changelogs
queries.sql_text:
SELECT DISTINCT
  i.id AS issue_id,
  ci.from_string AS original_from_value,
  ci.to_string AS original_to_value,
  NULL AS from_value,
  NULL AS to_value,
  cl.created AS created_date
FROM devlake.issues i
JOIN devlake._tool_jira_issue_changelogs cl
  ON i.id = CONCAT('jira', ':', 'JiraIssue', ':', cl.connection_id, ':', cl.issue_id)
JOIN devlake._tool_jira_issue_changelog_items ci
  ON ci.connection_id = cl.connection_id AND ci.changelog_id = cl.changelog_id
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM devlake.board_issues scoped_board WHERE scoped_board.issue_id = i.id AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM devlake.board_issues bi
    WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  )
  AND ci.field = 'status'
  AND i.status NOT IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS')
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND i.created_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND (i.original_project IN (:projectnames) OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys)))
  AND (:hasExcludeFilter = 0 OR i.original_project NOT IN (:excludeProjects))
  AND (:hasUserFilter = 0 OR i.assignee_name IN (:userwhitelist))
  AND (:from = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :from)
  AND (:to = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) <= :to)
ORDER BY issue_id, created_date ASC

queries.label: issues
queries.sql_text:
SELECT
  i.id,
  i.issue_key,
  i.original_project,
  i.created_date,
  i.resolution_date,
  i.status,
  i.assignee_name,
  i.component
FROM devlake.issues i
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM devlake.board_issues scoped_board WHERE scoped_board.issue_id = i.id AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM devlake.board_issues bi
    WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  )
  AND i.status NOT IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS')
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND i.created_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND (i.original_project IN (:projectnames) OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys)))
  AND (:hasExcludeFilter = 0 OR i.original_project NOT IN (:excludeProjects))
  AND (:hasUserFilter = 0 OR i.assignee_name IN (:userwhitelist))
  AND (:from = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :from)
  AND (:to = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) <= :to)
ORDER BY i.resolution_date DESC
